name: exercise_1_13b
informal_prefix: /-- Suppose that $f$ is holomorphic in an open set $\Omega$. Prove that if $\text{Im}(f)$ is constant, then $f$ is constant.-/
formal_statement:
theorem exercise_1_13b {f : ℂ → ℂ} (Ω : Set ℂ) (a b : Ω) (h : IsOpen Ω)
  (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω) (hc : ∃ (c : ℝ), ∀ z ∈ Ω, (f z).im = c) :
  f a = f b :=
goal:
f : ℂ → ℂ
Ω : Set ℂ
a b : ↑Ω
h : IsOpen Ω
hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω
hc : ∃ c, ∀ z ∈ Ω, (f z).im = c
⊢ f ↑a = f ↑b

name: exercise_1_1b
informal_prefix: /-- If $r$ is rational $(r \neq 0)$ and $x$ is irrational, prove that $rx$ is irrational.-/
formal_statement:
theorem exercise_1_1b
(x : ℝ)
(y : ℚ)
(h : y ≠ 0)
: ( Irrational x ) -> Irrational ( x * y ) :=
goal:
x : ℝ
y : ℚ
h : y ≠ 0
⊢ Irrational x → Irrational (x * ↑y)
